name: llm-framing-reactivity
description: Materials, data, and analysis code for A Framing-Robustness Evaluation Shows That Emotional Input Uniformly Shifts the Communication Style of Patient-Facing Large Language Models (October 2026). This release is the repository state at submission; all reported statistics reproduce from the included data with the seed-fixed scripts (see README). Included 60 patient vignettes (10 scenarios × 6 emotional framings), the 13-item rubric codebook shared by judge and human raters, the 7 worked examples of the judge prompt, and the blind prompt builder All 4,200 model responses (7 LLMs, April 2026), judge scores for every response, the two raters' codings of the 210-response validation sample, and per-response Tier-1/Tier-2 metrics IPIP-50 items, prompts, and raw and scored responses for all seven models Judge-validation gate, confirmatory permutation ANOVA, per-model ANOVAs, PCA/clustering, reactivity decomposition, and table scripts, with outputs at every stage Not included: the ~72 MB per-sentence classifier output ( can be regenerated from included inputs with score_goemo.py) License: MIT.
